notes: The copula goes to the predicate πάντα rather than to the subject noun Χριστός (rule 63), against the ASV's word order.

'cannot' is kept whole on the negator, the supplied modal riding along, since the fused word cannot be split; reading οὐκ ἔνι as one unit over 'there cannot be' remains defensible and is recorded in the unit note.
τὰ is unrepresented because the ASV writes no determiner and no supplied nominal for the predicate 'all' (rules 23, 102).
